card.name: Words introducing interacting drug classes
card.fires_on: Fires on the word right after a drug class or interaction cue, such as "agents" in "Alkalinizing Agents", "Antidiabetic agents" or "drugs that". It also fires on "hypers|ensitive" in contraindication lists.

modes.label: Drug class nouns in interaction tables
modes.description: The word "agents", "that" or "with" after a drug class or interaction phrase in a drug interaction section.
modes.example: Antidiabetic<< agents>> Hypoglycemia including fatal outcomes

modes.label: Hypersensitivity in contraindications
modes.description: The ending of "hypersensitive" in statements about being allergic to a component.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Cortifoam ® is contraindicated in patients who are hypers<<ensitive>> to any components of this product.

modes.label: Scattered punctuation and linking words
modes.description: Commas, prepositions or dashes in author lists, assignments and timelines outside drug text.
modes.example: * Y.S. Kim<<,>> R. Davis, A.A. Cain

card.plain: It lights up on the small word after a drug class in interaction lists and on "hypersensitive" in contraindications.
